Where the work sits in a deal

    Read the claims before the deal

    Findings the deal room can use

    A roadmap, not a surprise

    Remediation sequenced so a finding becomes a plan. Pre-existing billing liability survives acquisition; the DOJ has held buyers liable for failures they inherited.

Questions about DILIGENCE

How far back does the review go?

Twelve to twenty-four months of claims data, reviewed by CPC-certified coding specialists rather than sampled or inferred by a model.

Will the findings hold up with an underwriter?

The report is produced in the form representations and warranties underwriters expect, and comes with a post-close remediation roadmap so a finding becomes a plan rather than a surprise at closing.

How fast can we be up and running?

Most organizations are fully live in two to three weeks. Your advisor does the heavy lifting: policy customization, staff roster, training assignment. Your team spends about three hours in total.

Do we have to take the whole suite?

No. The four products work as one platform when you take them together, but each is sold on its own. Most organizations start with the piece they are most exposed on and add from there.

What does it cost?

Pricing scales with the size of your organization and the products you use, so a four-provider group is not quoted an enterprise number. The compliance review that starts the conversation is free, and the written findings are yours whether or not you become a client.
